findings.evidence: paper Eq.4.11 defines type + size + criticality priority; greedy_initialization code assigns only coarse type scores FREE=1000, compute=100, ALLOC=10/-1000
findings.impact: claimed priority model is not the implemented priority model

findings.evidence: paper says tabu length dynamically adjusts; code sets tabu_length=20 and only adjusts neighborhood_size

tabu_list starts as [] and update_tabu_list concatenates character move strings into one flat char stream then truncates by character length; ismember(move,tabu_list) tests character membership rather than exact move records
findings.impact: tabu memory does not behave as a FIFO queue of moves

findings.evidence: Mbest and local attractor P are computed but never referenced afterward; particle update uses inertia/c1/c2 velocity equation
findings.impact: visible implementation is PSO-like rather than verified quantum-behaved PSO

findings.evidence: fitness = 1.0*extraData(Bytes) + 0.1*execTime(Cycles) + penalty, with no scaling or lexicographic primary objective
findings.impact: secondary runtime can change the primary data-movement optimum due solely to units/magnitude

findings.evidence: local-search branch updates globalBest.fitness/fields when improved but does not update scalar globalBestFitness; following global-best comparison and convergence logging still use stale globalBestFitness
findings.impact: a local-search improvement can be overwritten or logged inconsistently

findings.evidence: Q2 Eq.5.20 charges 1*size for COPY_IN-used spill and 2*size otherwise; Q3 Eq.6.67 defines lambda=0 for COPY_IN-used spill and 1 otherwise
findings.impact: Q3 objective no longer measures the same extra data movement as Q2

findings.evidence: Appendix A ends after Q2 helper functions; no DPEA implementation is visible
findings.impact: Q3 reported gains cannot be traced to executable appendix code

findings.evidence: problem narrative requires transfer not significantly increase, but Q3 formalization treats transfer as a Pareto objective and does not encode the explicit 1.05*Q2 cap used by the case-group contract
findings.impact: method could return nondominated but contest-infeasible solutions
